_meta.description: Single source of truth for paper numerical values

materials_evaluation._note: Synthetic-data exploration demos; not real predictions

language_evaluation._note: Paired ja/en robustness test: English translations of the 100-query ablation set evaluated with identical gold SQL, expected results, database, and pipeline (full condition, 3 runs per language); plus a non-translated 25-query English validation set (independent_en_dataset.jsonl), newly authored in English without reference to the existing query sets, with its own gold SQL and expected results created after authoring and verified against the database. Difficulty labels of the non-translated set follow the unified complexity score recomputed from its gold SQL (scripts/compute_unified_difficulty.py); its difficulty distribution differs from the main evaluation, so its recall is not directly comparable in level to the main or paired results

paired_stats._note: Per-query three-run mean recall, en - ja (scripts/compute_language_stats.py); exact Wilcoxon signed-rank on non-zero differences and seeded bootstrap percentile CI
paired_stats.test: exhaustive sign-permutation test of the Wilcoxon signed-rank statistic (midranks for tied |diff|) on per-query 3-run mean recall (en - ja)

independent_evaluation._note: The earlier harmonized comparison has been removed; use the full independent rerun below (see n_queries). These queries are a subset of the main corpus; the rerun below is a separate run of that same subset.

main_run_subsets._note: Within-run breakdown of the single main run: the independently designed queries are a subset of the main corpus, evaluated here in the same run

transfer_evaluation._note: Transfer run against the OQMD-flavored transfer schema (flat layout, renamed columns; see db/transfer_schema.sql); no code changes

transfer_evaluation_variants._note: Transfer/generalization tests A--D; A is same-schema data expansion, B/C are code-unchanged schema transfer, D is lightweight MP adaptation (dedicated prompt plus a small few-shot set)

A_prototype_expansion._note: B2/NaCl/NiAs/BiF$_3$ prototype expansion on the same normalized main schema

B_oqmd_transfer._note: OQMD-flavored flat schema with renamed table and column names (db/transfer_schema.sql)

C_obfuscated._note: Randomized English table/column names preserving FK relationships

D_materials_project._note: Real Materials Project data in a fresh compact schema (see scripts/build_mp_transfer_db.py)

cte_evaluation_15._note: Original CTE patterns (few-shot covered) plus novel zero-shot patterns; counts in n_original / n_novel

figure_source_data._note: Verbatim evaluation JSON payloads consumed by scripts/generate_figures.py

provenance.prompt_template_note: SHA-256 of the static prompt template only; the prompt actually sent per query additionally contains dynamically injected few-shot examples, schema/JOIN listings and column hints, so it is not covered by this hash
provenance.rescore_note: aggregated deterministically from stored ablation_run_*.json; the per-run provenance in those files identifies the inference revision

re-scored deterministically from the stored generated SQL against the current gold/expected corpus by scripts/rescore_stored_results.py; no LLM call is involved (the generated SQL itself is unchanged)

results.sql:
SELECT m.formula, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ni'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.number_of_elements = 2
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c1
    WHERE c1.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c1.atomic_fraction = 0.75
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c2
    WHERE c2.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c2.atomic_fraction = 0.25
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    c.element = 'Co'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.crystal_system = 'cubic'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.strukturbericht, s.prototype, s.space_group_number, s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Al'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.space_group_number, s.space_group
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.space_group_number = 221
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND c.element = 'Ti'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    c.element = 'Pt'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c_ni
    WHERE c_ni.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c_ni.element = 'Ni'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c_al
    WHERE c_al.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c_al.element = 'Al'
)
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND c.element = 'Ga'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Fe'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT c.element, c.site_label
FROM composition c
WHERE c.site_label = 'A-site'
ORDER BY c.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system
FROM material_entry m
ORDER BY m.chemical_system, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.crystal_system, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂') OR s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂'))
  AND s.crystal_system = 'cubic'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND c.element = 'W'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  c.element,
  c.atomic_fraction,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  s.prototype
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ni'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.chemical_system, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.chemical_system ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.prototype,
  c.element,
  c.atomic_fraction,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Al'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0.001
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Co'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a >= 3.5
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.01
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ti'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE m.chemical_system = 'Al-Ni'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND s.lattice_a < 3.6
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Nb'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Sc'
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.chemical_system != 'Al-Ni'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS l12_compound_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY l12_compound_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a >= 4.0
ORDER BY s.lattice_a DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Pd'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'stable'
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'metastable'
    ELSE 'unstable'
  END AS stability
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Cu'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 1
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 2
    ELSE 3
  END,
  ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    c.site_label = 'B-site'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.volume_per_atom <= 12
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Ir'
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.chemical_system, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.number_of_elements = 2
ORDER BY m.chemical_system, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY s.lattice_a DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Ni'
  )
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  c_a.element AS a_site,
  c_a.atomic_fraction AS a_site_atomic_fraction,
  c_b.element AS b_site,
  c_b.atomic_fraction AS b_site_atomic_fraction,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
ORDER BY
  c_a.element,
  c_b.element,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) <= 0.1
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       AVG(s.lattice_a) AS avg_lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY c.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.3
  AND s.lattice_a BETWEEN 3.5 AND 3.7
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
  AND cp.value >= 180
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Co'
  AND c.atomic_fraction = 0.75
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    c.element,
    c.site_label,
    c.atomic_fraction,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
    AND c.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, cp.property_name, cp.value, cp.unit

SELECT

FROM material_entry m

WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

SELECT DISTINCT

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus

JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m

JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.formula IN ('Co3Ti', 'Ni3Al')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS stable_l12_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = FALSE) AS not_stable_l12_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id

  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id

  )
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0.001
    AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS b_site, COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS stable_l12_compound_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id

  AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  m.chemical_system,
  m.source_db,
  s.crystal_system,
  s.space_group_number,
  s.lattice_a,
  s.lattice_b,
  s.lattice_c,
  s.volume_per_atom,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m

WHERE
  s.strukturbericht IN ('L1₂', 'L12', 'L1_2')
  OR s.prototype IN ('L1₂', 'L12', 'L1_2')
ORDER BY m.formula, m.source_db
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND calc.functional = 'GGA-PBE'
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable,
       cp.property_name,
       cp.value,
       cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE c.element = 'Fe'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name IN ('C11', 'C12', 'C44')
ORDER BY m.formula, cp.property_name
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.value >= 160
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  c_a.element AS a_site,
  c_b.element AS b_site
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_a.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND c_b.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY m.formula, c_a.element, c_b.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull = 0
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND string_to_array(m.chemical_system, '-') && ARRAY[
    'Sc','Ti','V','Cr','Mn','Fe','Co','Ni','Cu','Zn',
    'Y','Zr','Nb','Mo','Tc','Ru','Rh','Pd','Ag','Cd',
    'Hf','Ta','W','Re','Os','Ir','Pt','Au','Hg'
  ]
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.number_of_elements >= 2
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, lattice_diff ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND m.number_of_elements >= 2
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
         ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  pde.hull_distance AS energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  (
    (1 - pde.hull_distance / 0.05) * 0.4
    + (1 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.3
    + (cp.value / 300.0) * 0.3
  ) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_diagram_entry pde ON pde.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND pde.hull_distance <= 0.05
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c
      WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c.element = 'Ni'
    )
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c
      WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c.element = 'Co'
    )
  )
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap, cp.property_name, cp.value, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
    AND c.site_label IN ('A-site', 'B-site')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  ((1 - ps.energy_above_hull / 0.05) * 0.35
   + (1 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.35
   + (cp.value / 300) * 0.30) AS total_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON m.entry_id = s.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON m.entry_id = ps.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON m.entry_id = calc.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON calc.calculation_id = cp.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY total_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  pde.hull_distance AS e_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus_b,
  (
    (1 - pde.hull_distance / 0.05) * 0.35
    + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.35
    + (LEAST(cp.value, 300) / 300) * 0.30
  ) AS score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_diagram_entry pde ON pde.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND pde.hull_distance <= 0.05
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
       m.formula,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Co'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY lattice_diff ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE
    (m.formula = 'Co3Ti' OR m.reduced_formula = 'Co3Ti')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC) AS ranking,
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'stable'
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull > 0.001 AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'metastable'
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull > 0.05 THEN 'unstable'
  END AS stability
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  (
    (1 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
    + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.25
    + CASE
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3 THEN 0.20
        ELSE 0.10
      END
  ) AS design_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.chemical_system <> 'Al-Ni'
ORDER BY design_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON m.entry_id = s.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON m.entry_id = ps.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON m.entry_id = calc.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON calc.calculation_id = cp.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.3
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
  AND cp.value >= 150
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC, cp.value ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn')
      THEN '3d_transition_metal_A_site'
    WHEN c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                       'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg')
      THEN '4d_5d_transition_metal_A_site'
  END AS a_site_group,
  COUNT(*) AS count,
  AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS stable_percentage,
  AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_eform
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn',
                    'Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                    'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg')
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn')
      THEN '3d_transition_metal_A_site'
    WHEN c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                       'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg')
      THEN '4d_5d_transition_metal_A_site'
  END
ORDER BY a_site_group
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE
  (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < (
    SELECT ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom
    FROM material_entry m_ref
    JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps_ref ON ps_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
    WHERE
      (m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al' OR m_ref.reduced_formula = 'Ni3Al')
      AND (s_ref.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    ORDER BY ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
    LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp.value > (
    SELECT cp_ref.value
    FROM material_entry m_ref
    JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
    JOIN calculated_property cp_ref ON cp_ref.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
    JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
    WHERE
      (m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al' OR m_ref.reduced_formula = 'Ni3Al')
      AND (s_ref.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref.strukturbericht = 'L12')
      AND cp_ref.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
    ORDER BY cp_ref.value DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
  cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS formation_energy_vs_element_ground_states, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  (
    (1 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
    + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.30
    + (-ps.formation_energy_per_atom / 1.0) * 0.20
  ) AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id

WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m

JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m

WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id

  AND ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) <= 0.1
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m

JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.formula IN ('Co3Ti', 'Ni3Al')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS stable_l12_al_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = FALSE) AS not_stable_l12_al_count
FROM material_entry m

  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Al'
  )
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0.001
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS b_site,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS stable_l12_compound_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY stable_l12_compound_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  m.source_db,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  s.crystal_system,
  s.space_group_number,
  s.lattice_a,
  s.lattice_b,
  s.lattice_c,

FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND calc.functional = 'GGA-PBE'
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable,
       cp.property_name,
       cp.value,
       cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

  AND cp.property_name IN ('C11', 'C12', 'C44')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.value >= 160
ORDER BY cp.value DESC

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c_a.element AS a_site, c_b.element AS b_site
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_a.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND c_b.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY m.formula, c_a.element, c_b.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    s.prototype,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.energy_above_hull = 0
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)(Sc|Ti|V|Cr|Mn|Fe|Co|Ni|Cu|Zn|Y|Zr|Nb|Mo|Tc|Ru|Rh|Pd|Ag|Cd|Hf|Ta|W|Re|Os|Ir|Pt|Au|Hg|Rf|Db|Sg|Bh|Hs|Mt|Ds|Rg|Cn)(-|$)'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND m.number_of_elements >= 2
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
         ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  pde.hull_distance AS energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  ((1.0 - pde.hull_distance / 0.05) * 0.4
   + (1.0 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.3
   + (cp.value / 300.0) * 0.3) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_diagram_entry pde ON pde.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND pde.hull_distance <= 0.05
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull, cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c_ni
      WHERE c_ni.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c_ni.element = 'Ni'
    )
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c_co
      WHERE c_co.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c_co.element = 'Co'
    )
  )
ORDER BY cp_bm.value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  c_a.element AS a_site,
  c_b.element AS b_site,
  COUNT(*) AS l12_combination_count,
  AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
GROUP BY c_a.element, c_b.element
ORDER BY stable_percentage DESC, avg_energy_above_hull ASC, l12_combination_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  ((1.0 - ps.energy_above_hull / 0.05) * 0.35
   + (1.0 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.35
   + (cp.value / 300.0) * 0.30) AS total_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY total_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  phase_diagram_entry.hull_distance AS e_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  ((1 - phase_diagram_entry.hull_distance / 0.05) * 0.35
   + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.35
   + (LEAST(cp.value, 300) / 300) * 0.30) AS score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_diagram_entry ON phase_diagram_entry.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND phase_diagram_entry.hull_distance <= 0.05
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Co'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

WITH compound AS (
    SELECT m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.reference_set
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    WHERE m.formula = 'Co3Ti'
    LIMIT 1
),
ref_energies AS (
    SELECT c.entry_id,
           SUM(comp.atomic_fraction * per.delta_e) AS weighted_ref
    FROM compound c
    JOIN composition comp ON comp.entry_id = c.entry_id
    JOIN pure_element_reference per ON per.element_symbol = comp.element
        AND per.reference_set = c.reference_set
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
)
SELECT c.formula,
       c.formation_energy_per_atom,
       r.weighted_ref AS ref_energy,
       c.formation_energy_per_atom - r.weighted_ref AS corrected_enthalpy
FROM compound c
JOIN ref_energies r ON r.entry_id = c.entry_id
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'stable'
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'metastable'
    ELSE 'unstable'
  END AS stability
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  (
    (1.0 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
    + (1.0 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.25
    + CASE
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3 THEN 0.20
        ELSE 0.10
      END
  ) AS design_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.chemical_system <> 'Al-Ni'
ORDER BY design_score DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, lattice_diff ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.3
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
  AND cp.value >= 150
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC, cp.value ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT CASE
         WHEN c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn') THEN '3d_transition_metal_A_site'
         WHEN c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                            'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg') THEN '4d_5d_transition_metal_A_site'
       END AS a_site_transition_metal_group,
       COUNT(*) AS count,
       AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_eform
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn',
                    'Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                    'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg')
GROUP BY CASE
           WHEN c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn') THEN '3d_transition_metal_A_site'
           WHEN c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                              'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg') THEN '4d_5d_transition_metal_A_site'
         END
ORDER BY a_site_transition_metal_group
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    s.lattice_a,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
    AND NOT (
        m.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
        OR m.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
    )
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < (
        SELECT
            ps.formation_energy_per_atom
        FROM material_entry m
        JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
        JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
        WHERE
            (m.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR m.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
            AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
        ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
        LIMIT 1
    )
    AND cp.value > (
        SELECT
            cp.value
        FROM material_entry m
        JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
        JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
        JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
        WHERE
            (m.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR m.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
            AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
            AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
        ORDER BY cp.value DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS rebased_formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  (
    (1 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
    + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.30
    + 0.0 * 0.20
    + (-ps.formation_energy_per_atom / 1.0) * 0.20
  ) AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS shear_modulus, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'shear_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ni'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
    AND c.site_label = 'A-site'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) <= 0.1
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY cp.value DESC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.formula IN ('Co3Ti', 'Ni3Al')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS stable_l12_al_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = FALSE) AS unstable_l12_al_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Al'
  )
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0.001
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS b_site,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS stable_l12_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY stable_l12_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  m.source_db,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  s.crystal_system,
  s.space_group_number,
  s.space_group,
  s.lattice_a,
  s.lattice_b,
  s.lattice_c,
  s.volume_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND calc.functional = 'GGA-PBE'
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable,
       cp_c11.value AS C11,
       cp_c12.value AS C12,
       cp_c44.value AS C44
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_c11.property_name = 'C11'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_c12.property_name = 'C12'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_c44.property_name = 'C44'
WHERE c.element = 'Fe'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.value >= 160
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula,
       c_a.element AS a_site,
       c_a.atomic_fraction AS a_site_atomic_fraction,
       c_b.element AS b_site,
       c_b.atomic_fraction AS b_site_atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_a.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND c_b.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY m.formula, c_a.element, c_b.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull = 0
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND string_to_array(m.chemical_system, '-') && ARRAY[
    'Sc','Ti','V','Cr','Mn','Fe','Co','Ni','Cu','Zn',
    'Y','Zr','Nb','Mo','Tc','Ru','Rh','Pd','Ag','Cd',
    'Hf','Ta','W','Re','Os','Ir','Pt','Au','Hg',
    'Rf','Db','Sg','Bh','Hs','Mt','Ds','Rg','Cn'
  ]
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.number_of_elements > 1
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND (
      EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM composition c_ni
          WHERE c_ni.entry_id = m.entry_id
            AND c_ni.element = 'Ni'
      )
      OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM composition c_co
          WHERE c_co.entry_id = m.entry_id
            AND c_co.element = 'Co'
      )
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
         ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    pde.hull_distance AS e_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
    ((1 - pde.hull_distance / 0.05) * 0.4
     + (1 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.3
     + (cp.value / 300.0) * 0.3) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_diagram_entry pde ON pde.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND pde.hull_distance <= 0.05
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c
      WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c.element = 'Ni'
    )
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c
      WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c.element = 'Co'
    )
  )
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap, cp.property_name, cp.value, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
    AND c.site_label IN ('A-site', 'B-site')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  ((1 - ps.energy_above_hull / 0.05) * 0.35
   + (1 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.35
   + (cp.value / 300) * 0.30) AS total_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
  AND cp.value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY total_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  pde.hull_distance AS e_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  ((1 - pde.hull_distance / 0.05) * 0.35
   + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.35
   + (LEAST(cp.value, 300) / 300) * 0.30) AS score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_diagram_entry pde ON pde.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND pde.hull_distance <= 0.05
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c
      WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c.element = 'Co'
  )
ORDER BY lattice_diff ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE
    (m.formula = 'Co3Ti' OR m.reduced_formula = 'Co3Ti')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'stable'
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'metastable'
    ELSE 'unstable'
  END AS stability
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  (
    (1 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
    + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.25
    + CASE
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3 THEN 0.20
        ELSE 0.10
      END
  ) AS design_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.chemical_system != 'Al-Ni'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY design_score DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    s.lattice_a,
    cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.3
    AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
    AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
    AND cp.value >= 150
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT CASE
         WHEN c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn') THEN '3d_transition_metals'
         WHEN c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                            'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg') THEN '4d_5d_transition_metals'
       END AS a_site_transition_metal_group,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS count,
       AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_eform
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn',
                    'Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                    'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg')
GROUP BY a_site_transition_metal_group
ORDER BY a_site_transition_metal_group
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < (
    SELECT ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom
    FROM material_entry m_ref
    JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps_ref ON ps_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
    WHERE (m_ref.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR m_ref.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
      AND (s_ref.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    ORDER BY ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
    LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp.value > (
    SELECT cp_ref.value
    FROM material_entry m_ref
    JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
    JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
    JOIN calculated_property cp_ref ON cp_ref.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
    WHERE (m_ref.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR m_ref.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
      AND (s_ref.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref.strukturbericht = 'L12')
      AND cp_ref.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
    ORDER BY cp_ref.value DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )
  AND NOT (m.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR m.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       ps.is_stable,
       s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  (
    (1 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
    + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.30
    + 0.0
    + (-ps.formation_energy_per_atom / 1.0) * 0.20
  ) AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY composite_score DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20;
