WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0.001
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS b_site,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS stable_l12_compound_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY stable_l12_compound_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  m.source_db,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  s.crystal_system,
  s.space_group_number,
  s.space_group,
  s.lattice_a,
  s.lattice_b,
  s.lattice_c,
  s.volume_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND calc.functional = 'GGA-PBE'
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable,
       cp.property_name,
       cp.value,
       cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE c.element = 'Fe'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name IN ('C11', 'C12', 'C44')
ORDER BY m.formula, cp.property_name
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.value >= 160
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
    AND ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.572) <= 0.03

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  c_a.element AS a_site,
  c_a.atomic_fraction AS a_site_atomic_fraction,
  c_b.element AS b_site,
  c_b.atomic_fraction AS b_site_atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_a.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND c_b.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY m.formula, c_a.element, c_b.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.energy_above_hull = 0
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)(Sc|Ti|V|Cr|Mn|Fe|Co|Ni|Cu|Zn|Y|Zr|Nb|Mo|Tc|Ru|Rh|Pd|Ag|Cd|Hf|Ta|W|Re|Os|Ir|Pt|Au|Hg|Rf|Db|Sg|Bh|Hs|Mt|Ds|Rg|Cn)(-|$)'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.number_of_elements > 1
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND (
      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM composition c_ni WHERE c_ni.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c_ni.element = 'Ni')
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM composition c_co WHERE c_co.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c_co.element = 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
         ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       s.lattice_a,
       cp_eh.value AS energy_above_hull,
       cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
       ((1 - cp_eh.value / 0.05) * 0.4
        + (1 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.3
        + (cp_bm.value / 300.0) * 0.3) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_eh ON cp_eh.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_eh.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp_eh.value <= 0.05
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c
      WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c.element = 'Ni'
    )
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c
      WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c.element = 'Co'
    )
  )
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  m.chemical_system,
  s.formula_type,
  COUNT(*) AS count,
  AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ps.is_stable = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unstable_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
GROUP BY m.chemical_system, s.formula_type
ORDER BY stable_percentage DESC, avg_energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  ((1 - ps.energy_above_hull / 0.05) * 0.35
   + (1 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.35
   + (cp.value / 300) * 0.30) AS total_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY total_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  cp_eh.value AS energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp_b.value AS bulk_modulus,
  (
    (1 - cp_eh.value / 0.05) * 0.35
    + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.35
    + (LEAST(cp_b.value, 300) / 300) * 0.30
  ) AS score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc_eh ON calc_eh.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_eh ON cp_eh.calculation_id = calc_eh.calculation_id
JOIN calculation calc_b ON calc_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_b ON cp_b.calculation_id = calc_b.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp_eh.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
  AND cp_eh.value <= 0.05
  AND cp_b.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Co'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE
    (m.formula = 'Co3Ti' OR m.reduced_formula = 'Co3Ti')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'stable'
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull > 0.001 AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'metastable'
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull > 0.05 THEN 'unstable'
  END AS stability
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
  (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  (
    (1 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
    + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.25
    + CASE
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3 THEN 0.20
        ELSE 0.10
      END
  ) AS design_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.chemical_system != 'Al-Ni'
ORDER BY design_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.3
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
  AND cp.value >= 150
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT CASE
           WHEN m.formula ~ '(Sc|Ti|V|Cr|Mn|Fe|Co|Ni|Cu|Zn)3' THEN '3d_transition_metal_A_site'
           WHEN m.formula ~ '(Y|Zr|Nb|Mo|Tc|Ru|Rh|Pd|Ag|Cd|Hf|Ta|W|Re|Os|Ir|Pt|Au|Hg)3' THEN '4d_5d_transition_metal_A_site'
       END AS a_site_period_group,
       COUNT(*) AS count,
       AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_eform
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND (
      m.formula ~ '(Sc|Ti|V|Cr|Mn|Fe|Co|Ni|Cu|Zn)3'
      OR m.formula ~ '(Y|Zr|Nb|Mo|Tc|Ru|Rh|Pd|Ag|Cd|Hf|Ta|W|Re|Os|Ir|Pt|Au|Hg)3'
  )
GROUP BY a_site_period_group
ORDER BY a_site_period_group
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    s.lattice_a,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < (
        SELECT phase_stability.formation_energy_per_atom
        FROM material_entry
        JOIN structure ON structure.entry_id = material_entry.entry_id
        JOIN phase_stability ON phase_stability.entry_id = material_entry.entry_id
        WHERE
            (material_entry.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR material_entry.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
            AND (structure.prototype = 'L12' OR structure.strukturbericht = 'L12')
        ORDER BY phase_stability.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
        LIMIT 1
    )
    AND cp.value > (
        SELECT calculated_property.value
        FROM material_entry
        JOIN structure ON structure.entry_id = material_entry.entry_id
        JOIN calculation ON calculation.entry_id = material_entry.entry_id
        JOIN calculated_property ON calculated_property.calculation_id = calculation.calculation_id
        WHERE
            (material_entry.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR material_entry.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
            AND (structure.prototype = 'L12' OR structure.strukturbericht = 'L12')
            AND calculated_property.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
        ORDER BY calculated_property.value DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS rebased_formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  s.lattice_a,
  (
    (1 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
    + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.30
    + 0.0 * 0.20
    + (-ps.formation_energy_per_atom / 1.0) * 0.20
  ) AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_eform
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS renormalized_formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.element = 'Ni'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.1
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction, s.prototype
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ni'
  AND m.number_of_elements > 1
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.number_of_elements = 2
  AND (
    m.reduced_formula ~ '^[A-Z][a-z]?3[A-Z][a-z]?$'
    OR m.reduced_formula ~ '^[A-Z][a-z]?[A-Z][a-z]?3$'
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    c.element = 'Co'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.crystal_system = 'cubic'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    c.element = 'Al'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.space_group_number
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.space_group_number = 221
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.formula LIKE '%Ti%'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.chemical_system = 'Pt'
   OR m.chemical_system LIKE 'Pt-%'

WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.value >= 160
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT

FROM material_entry m
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
    AND ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.572) <= 0.03

SELECT DISTINCT

FROM material_entry m

JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND c_b.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom, s.lattice_a

JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'

SELECT

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable

SELECT

FROM material_entry m

  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c
      WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id

      FROM composition c

SELECT

FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY lattice_score_component DESC

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable

      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c

        AND c.element = 'Ni'
    )
    OR EXISTS (

      FROM composition c

SELECT
  m.chemical_system AS element_combination,
  COUNT(*) AS count,
  AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ps.energy_above_hull > 0.001 AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS metastable_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ps.energy_above_hull > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unstable_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
GROUP BY m.chemical_system
ORDER BY avg_energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  ((1 - ps.energy_above_hull / 0.05) * 0.35
   + (1 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.35) AS score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  cp_eh.value AS energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp_b.value AS bulk_modulus,
  ((1 - cp_eh.value / 0.05) * 0.35
   + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.35
   + (LEAST(cp_b.value, 300) / 300) * 0.30) AS score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_eh ON cp_eh.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_b ON cp_b.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp_eh.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
  AND cp_eh.value <= 0.05
  AND cp_b.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,

JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Co'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    CASE
        WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'stable'
        WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'metastable'
        ELSE 'unstable'
    END AS stability
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  (
    (1 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
    + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.25
    + CASE
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3 THEN 0.20
        ELSE 0.10
      END
  ) AS design_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.chemical_system != 'Al-Ni'
ORDER BY design_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count,

       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_eform
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

SELECT
    m.formula,

    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND NOT (
        m.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
        OR m.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
    )
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < (
        SELECT ps2.formation_energy_per_atom
        FROM material_entry m2
        JOIN structure s2 ON s2.entry_id = m2.entry_id
        JOIN phase_stability ps2 ON ps2.entry_id = m2.entry_id
        WHERE
            (m2.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR m2.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
            AND (s2.prototype = 'L12' OR s2.strukturbericht = 'L12')
            AND ps2.reference_set = ps.reference_set
        ORDER BY ps2.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
        LIMIT 1

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m

WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

SELECT
  ranked.rank,
  ranked.formula,
  ranked.energy_above_hull,
  ranked.lattice_a,
  ranked.lattice_diff,
  ranked.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ranked.composite_score
FROM (
  SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    (
      (1 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
      + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.30
      + 0.0 * 0.20
      + (-ps.formation_energy_per_atom / 1.0) * 0.20
    ) AS composite_score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY
        (
          (1 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
          + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.30
          + 0.0 * 0.20
          + (-ps.formation_energy_per_atom / 1.0) * 0.20
        ) DESC
    ) AS rank
  FROM material_entry m
  JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
  JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
  WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
    AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
) ranked
ORDER BY ranked.composite_score DESC
LIMIT 20;

JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE m.chemical_system = 'Al-Ni'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a < 3.6
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull,
       CASE
         WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'stable'
         WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'metastable'
         ELSE 'unstable'
       END AS stability
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Nb'
  )
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.formula ~ 'Sc'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY m.formula ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.chemical_system != 'Al-Ni'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site, COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS l12_compound_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY l12_compound_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a >= 4.0
ORDER BY s.lattice_a DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (
    m.chemical_system = 'Pd'
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE 'Pd-%'
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Pd-%'
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Pd'
)
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.formula ~ 'Cu([0-9A-Z]|$)'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.volume_per_atom <= 12
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.chemical_system = 'Ir'
   OR m.chemical_system LIKE 'Ir-%'
   OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Ir'
   OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Ir-%'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.chemical_system, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.number_of_elements = 2
ORDER BY m.chemical_system, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY s.lattice_a DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_eh ON cp_eh.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_proto ON cp_proto.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (m.chemical_system = 'Ni' OR m.chemical_system LIKE 'Ni-%' OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Ni-%' OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Ni')
  AND cp_eh.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
  AND cp_eh.value <= 0.05
  AND cp_proto.property_name = 'prototype'
  AND cp_proto.tensor_component = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       m.chemical_system,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE m.number_of_elements = 2
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY m.chemical_system, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) <= 0.1
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (
    m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)Ni($|-)'
    OR m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)Co($|-)'
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, AVG(s.lattice_a) AS avg_lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
GROUP BY m.formula
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.3
  AND s.lattice_a BETWEEN 3.5 AND 3.7
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
  AND cp.value >= 180
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND (m.formula LIKE 'Co3%' OR m.reduced_formula LIKE 'Co3%')
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE m.formula LIKE '%Al%'
   OR m.formula LIKE '%Ti%'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS shear_modulus, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'shear_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)Ni(-|$)'
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, cp.value ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_eform
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) <= 0.1
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY cp.value DESC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.formula IN ('Co3Ti', 'Ni3Al')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS stable_l12_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = FALSE) AS not_stable_l12_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Al'
  )
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.energy_above_hull > 0.001
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS b_site, COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS stable_l12_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY stable_l12_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, m.source_db, m.source_material_id
FROM material_entry m
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE calc.functional = 'GGA-PBE'
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.property_name, cp.tensor_component, cp.value, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE m.formula LIKE '%Fe%'
  AND (
    cp.property_name IN ('energy_above_hull', 'C11', 'C12', 'C44')
    OR cp.tensor_component IN ('C11', 'C12', 'C44')
  )
ORDER BY m.formula, cp.property_name, cp.tensor_component
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
  AND cp.value >= 160
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_a.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND c_b.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    ps.energy_above_hull = 0
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN element e ON e.symbol = c.element
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001
  AND e.category = 'transition_metal'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.number_of_elements >= 2
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC,
         ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND m.number_of_elements >= 2
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
         ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       s.lattice_a,
       cp_hull.value AS energy_above_hull,
       cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
       ((1.0 - cp_hull.value / 0.05) * 0.4
        + (1.0 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.3
        + (cp_bm.value / 300.0) * 0.3) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_hull ON cp_hull.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_hull.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp_hull.value <= 0.05
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND (m.formula LIKE '%Ni%' OR m.formula LIKE '%Co%')
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT m.formula,
       COUNT(*) AS total_calculations,
       AVG(cp.value) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cp.value <= 0.001) AS count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cp.value > 0.001 AND cp.value <= 0.05) AS metastable_count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cp.value > 0.05) AS unstable_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
GROUP BY m.formula
ORDER BY avg_energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
  cp_eh.value AS energy_above_hull,
  ((1 - cp_eh.value / 0.05) * 0.35
   + (1 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.35
   + (cp_bm.value / 300) * 0.30) AS overall_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
JOIN calculated_property cp_eh ON cp_eh.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_eh.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp_eh.value <= 0.001
ORDER BY overall_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  cp_ehull.value AS energy_above_hull,
  cp_a.value AS lattice_a,
  cp_b.value AS bulk_modulus,
  (1 - cp_ehull.value / 0.05) * 0.35
    + (1 - LEAST(ABS(cp_a.value - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.35
    + (LEAST(cp_b.value, 300) / 300) * 0.30 AS precipitation_strengthening_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_ehull ON cp_ehull.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_a ON cp_a.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_b ON cp_b.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_l12 ON cp_l12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp_l12.property_name = 'prototype_L12'
  AND cp_l12.value = 1
  AND cp_ehull.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
  AND cp_ehull.value <= 0.05
  AND cp_a.property_name = 'lattice_a'
  AND cp_b.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY precipitation_strengthening_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       cp_eh.value AS energy_above_hull,
       cp_la.value AS lattice_a,
       ABS(cp_la.value - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_eh ON cp_eh.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_eh.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
JOIN calculated_property cp_la ON cp_la.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_la.property_name = 'lattice_a'
WHERE (m.chemical_system = 'Co'
       OR m.chemical_system LIKE 'Co-%'
       OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Co-%'
       OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Co')
  AND cp_eh.value <= 0.001
ORDER BY cp_eh.value ASC, ABS(cp_la.value - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.formula = 'Co3Ti'
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'stable'
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'metastable'
    ELSE 'unstable'
  END AS stability
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.is_stable,
  (
    (1 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
    + CASE
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3 THEN 0.20
        ELSE 0.10
      END
  ) AS design_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.chemical_system != 'Al-Ni'
ORDER BY design_score DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.3
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
  AND cp.value >= 150
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC, cp.value ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  a_site_d_block_group,
  COUNT(*) AS count,
  AVG(energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_stable = TRUE) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS stable_percentage,
  AVG(formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_eform
FROM (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN m.reduced_formula ~ '(Sc3|Ti3|V3|Cr3|Mn3|Fe3|Co3|Ni3|Cu3|Zn3)($|[A-Z])'
        THEN '3d_transition_metal_A_site'
      WHEN m.reduced_formula ~ '(Y3|Zr3|Nb3|Mo3|Tc3|Ru3|Rh3|Pd3|Ag3|Cd3|Hf3|Ta3|W3|Re3|Os3|Ir3|Pt3|Au3|Hg3)($|[A-Z])'
        THEN '4d_5d_transition_metal_A_site'
    END AS a_site_d_block_group,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
  FROM material_entry m
  JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
  WHERE m.number_of_elements = 2
    AND (
      m.reduced_formula ~ '(Sc3|Ti3|V3|Cr3|Mn3|Fe3|Co3|Ni3|Cu3|Zn3)($|[A-Z])'
      OR m.reduced_formula ~ '(Y3|Zr3|Nb3|Mo3|Tc3|Ru3|Rh3|Pd3|Ag3|Cd3|Hf3|Ta3|W3|Re3|Os3|Ir3|Pt3|Au3|Hg3)($|[A-Z])'
    )
) AS grouped_materials
GROUP BY a_site_d_block_group
ORDER BY a_site_d_block_group
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND m.number_of_elements = 2
  AND (
      m.formula ~ '^[A-Z][a-z]?3[A-Z][a-z]?$'
      OR m.formula ~ '^[A-Z][a-z]?[A-Z][a-z]?3$'
      OR m.reduced_formula ~ '^[A-Z][a-z]?3[A-Z][a-z]?$'
      OR m.reduced_formula ~ '^[A-Z][a-z]?[A-Z][a-z]?3$'
  )
  AND NOT (
      m.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
      OR m.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
  )
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < (
      SELECT ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN phase_stability ps_ref ON ps_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      WHERE m_ref.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
         OR m_ref.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
      ORDER BY ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp.value > (
      SELECT cp_ref.value
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN calculated_property cp_ref ON cp_ref.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
      WHERE (m_ref.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
         OR m_ref.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
        AND cp_ref.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
      ORDER BY cp_ref.value DESC
      LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS rebased_formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    (
        (1 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
        + (-ps.formation_energy_per_atom / 1.0) * 0.20
    ) AS composite_score_available_terms
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY composite_score_available_terms DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT m.formula,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_referenced_formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
GROUP BY m.formula
ORDER BY avg_referenced_formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS rebased_formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.formula LIKE '%Ni%'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.1
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT

JOIN material_entry m ON (
